members.name: support_resistance_reversal_v1
members.thesis: Exploiting reversals at 2+ day support/resistance with high-low pattern change. Inefficiency from institutional accumulation at levels. Not arbitraged due to multi-day filter + volume + VIX requirement.
weaknesses: Regime dependency: strong trends break S/R
Liquidity constraints: thin stocks at levels
Crowding: S/R setups core of Gujral style on X

members.name: ema200_dip_reversal_v1
members.thesis: Exploiting bounces from 200-period EMA on 5-min after multi-day support formation. Inefficiency from retail panic selling at visible levels. Not arbitraged because requires 2-day prior support + volume spike; costs + latency kill it for non-quants.
weaknesses: Regime dependency: strong downtrends break 200 EMA
Liquidity constraints: slower stocks have execution lag
Crowding: Ashwani Gujral style widely followed on X
members.prior_art: 200 EMA dip + multi-day support (Ashwani Gujral X post)
